scope: Atomic display publication and explicit Auto-cycle reset for the existing ResetRange consumer; no product or family acceptance
cause: Resetting the cycle before display publication changes it on publication failure. Resetting afterward permits an allocation failure or an interleaving after display mutation.
publication: Allocate the prospective controller and replacement opaque epoch before taking the Application membership lock or mutating display.
Resolve expected's exact registered owner and use Document::set_display_if_current for identity and all-four-revision validation under the existing locks.
Successful equal-state publication advances Display exactly once. Preserve Pixels/Metadata/Selection, pixel/data/save identity, history/dirty state and supplied unrelated display state.
If the captured owner is active at publication, clear the Auto key/divisor and replace its epoch without allocation or callbacks after display mutation.

If the captured owner is inactive, publish only its display. Preserve the active owner's Auto key/divisor/epoch and pending work. This retains existing inactive-owner display editing without resetting an unrelated active workflow.
Stale, foreign, closed, invalid-display and constraint failures change neither display nor cycle. No pixel/provider acquisition is required.
consumers: Window prepares OutputPublication and the proposed ResetRange display before calling this seam. Append the record only after successful native publication.
Ordinary numeric Set and recorded Auto replay preserve the live cycle. Explicit zero-argument reset_auto_contrast_cycle remains available without a display edit.
Both shared Dear ImGui launch modes and the Python API consume the same native implementation.
required_assertions: First-controller and equal-display success; exactly one Display revision and no history/data/dirty effects
Successful active reset invalidates a preexisting READY Auto capture
Each failed guard preserves cycle and leaves otherwise valid pending Auto work publishable
Inactive-owner reset preserves the active owner's cycle and READY Auto publication
All four stale revisions, foreign identity, closed membership, invalid display and constraint refusal
No source reads; C++ API, Python API, installed SDK and both actual shared controls
unchanged: Original command arithmetic/wire, all six prior Application methods, resource limits, replay/rebind and complete family/platform/release obligations remain required.
